description: This PHP source file defines a custom exception class 'PasswordEnforceException' used within the OrangeHRM system, specifically in the authentication plugin module. The class handles password enforcement scenarios, including generating reset codes and providing redirect URLs to enforce password strength requirements.

classes.name: PasswordEnforceException
classes.description: A custom exception class for handling password enforcement failures, including generating a password reset code and redirecting users to a password change page.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor method initializing the exception with a name and message.

methods.name: generateResetCode
methods.description: Generates a reset code by logging a password enforce request via an external password strength service.

methods.name: getRedirectUrl
methods.description: Returns the URL to redirect the user to reset their weak password, incorporating the generated reset code.
